mcard-01-c1.text: Reinitz, M. T., Lammers, W. J., & Cochran, B. P (1992). Memory-conjunction errors: miscombination of stored stimulus features can produce illusions of memory. Memory & cognition.
mcard-01-c1.quote: We demonstrate that subjects will often claim to have previously seen a new stimulus if they have previously seen stimuli containing its component features.
mcard-01-c1.claim: People often claimed to have seen a new item if they had previously seen items containing its parts.

mcard-01-c1.text: Reinitz, M. T., Lammers, W. J., & Cochran, B. P (1992). Memory-conjunction errors: miscombination of stored stimulus features can produce illusions of memory. Memory & cognition.

mcard-01-c1.text: Reinitz, M. T., Lammers, W. J., & Cochran, B. P (1992). Memory-conjunction errors: miscombination of stored stimulus features can produce illusions of memory. Memory & cognition.
